description:
Is Video me maine bataya hai ki NCB Kya Hota Hai? or What is No Claim Bonus in a Vehicle Insurance Policy? and how to get no claim bonus?

WATCH NEXT:
○ Difference between First Party and Third Party Insurance: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G7YA5znOIm4
○ How To Get Free Instagram Followers and Likes - https://youtu.be/3iZ7Sn26bus

What is the benefit of no claim bonus and what will happen if we select wrong NCB, while purchasing a policy? Also I shared can we get no claim bonus in a third party insurance or not?

Ask Your Question or chit chat!
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/indian.munendra
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/indian.munendra

Aur Ha'an, Yaad se Channel Subscribe Jarur Kar lena hai!

QUERIES SOLVED:
○ what is the benefit of no claim bonus,
○ kya hum third party insurance main no claim bonus le sakte hain,
○ ncb in insurance means,
○ no claim bonus se kya fayada milta hai,
○ no claim bonus kaise milega,
